description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'Currency' within the OpenCart framework, responsible for managing currency-related tasks such as generating currency lists, listing currency JSON files, and clearing cached currency data. It contains methods 'index', 'list', and 'clear' that coordinate to automate the handling of currency data across different stores and languages.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class in the OpenCart admin module responsible for currency task management including list generation, listing, and clearing operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates tasks to clear previous currency data and populate new currency list tasks for each store and language.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Creates a JSON currency list file for a specific store and language, validating inputs and writing to the filesystem.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing currency JSON files for all stores and languages to reset cached data.
